 TXT, ATEEZ and ENHYPEN Headline a Packed November of K-Pop Comebacks
 November 6, 2026 by Contributor 
 Courtesy of BIGHIT MUSIC 
 Ten releases land between 6 and 20 November, from a vampire saga's finale to a debut solo. Here is who is back, when, and what to listen for. 
 November’s K-pop calendar has ten release dates on it, and three of them deserve a circle in thick marker: ATEEZ on the 13th, TOMORROW X TOGETHER on the 16th, and ENHYPEN on the 20th. Here are the K-pop comebacks November has in store, starting with the heavy hitters.
 The big three
 ATEEZ, 13 November. The pirate kings return with GOLDEN HOUR : Part 6 , their fifteenth mini album, after tearing up stages with pre-release track “Drip”. There is a bigger payoff down the line, too: their 2027 world tour, Zero To All, opens in Incheon on 22 January 2027, so expect these songs to be in the setlist.
 Courtesy of JYP Entertainment / Stray Kids Japan Official 
 TOMORROW X TOGETHER, 16 November. PERFECT STORM is the group’s ninth mini-album, with six new tracks, arriving ahead of their fifth world tour, Steal The Wind. For MOAs, it is another chapter in the Star Seekers lore that runs through the group’s discography.
 ENHYPEN, 20 November. This is the group’s third comeback of the year, and it carries a sense of an ending. THE SIN : PARALLEL WORLD is a spinoff single with three tracks that closes the THE SIN series. The title track, “I Want You”, tells a story of fate and connection between two people. ENHYPEN’s Blood Saga World Tour reaches Singapore’s National Stadium on 14 March 2027.
 Dance floors, solo debuts and sub-units
 NCT Dream, 9 November. After a long year of waiting, NCTzens get DREAM AFTER DREAM . The music video for “The Sun”, a b-side, dropped on 20 October, and the title track is “Boogie Woogie”. The name alone says where this one is headed: the dance floor.
 Chaeryeong, 9 November. The ITZY member is the third in the group to go solo, and her debut, Lovesick , comes with four tracks. If you are still nursing post-concert blues from ITZY’s October show, this is a handy remedy.
 ZEROBASEONE EMP, 10 November. The sub-unit of Seok Matthew and Park Gunwook returns with the digital single OFF script . The title track “Run” features hip-hop duo Dynamic Duo, the pair behind “AEAO”. It is a pairing that makes sense on paper and promises to be more interesting in practice.
 LNGSHOT, 10 November. The group is fresh off Jay Park’s Serenades & Body Rolls Latin America tour and has already moved on to the EP S.W.I.S.H. Pre-release track “Masterpiece”, out 21 October, earned them praise for its musicality and gave SHOTTIES a groove to hold onto until the full release.
 Courtesy of JYP Entertainment / Stray Kids Japan Official 
 Back in the spotlight
 P1Harmony, 6 November. The first out of the gate, and already out today. BLOW UP is the group’s tenth mini-album and arrives eight months after their last return. It leans into a cool hero concept and builds on the storylines of earlier albums UNIQUE and DUH! , so P1ece have some narrative threads to follow.
 NAYEON, 20 November. The TWICE member returns with the solo single “NA-sty”. Few details have been shared so far, but her track record does the talking: “ABCD” and “POP!” were both enormous, and the new single is pitched as another fun, irresistible hit.
 Yves, 20 November. Her fifth EP, Cute & Anxiety , is on the way, and two pre-release tracks arrived on 27 October. “Hysteric” rides a dark, alluring house groove, while “Adam” goes for something more experimental and spacey. For fans in Singapore, she also plays the Esplanade Annexe Studio on 4 November 2026.
 How to plan your month
 The calendar clusters neatly. The first ten days are for catching up: P1Harmony opens the month, NCT Dream and Chaeryeong share the 9th, and ZEROBASEONE EMP and LNGSHOT share the 10th. Then comes ATEEZ, TXT, and a final-week triple of NAYEON, Yves and ENHYPEN, all on the 20th. Check your streaming queue before that one.
 There is also plenty to look forward to beyond the release dates. ATEEZ’s tour starts in January, TXT’s is on the horizon, and ENHYPEN lands in Singapore in March. Many of these songs will get a live outing sooner than you might think.
 Via Harper's Bazaar Singapore
